description: How the RS-Agent XP-rate benchmark scoring works and key environment quirks (8x speed server)

The benchmark score is the peak XP/min measured by `bun /app/benchmark/shared/check_xp_rate.ts <Skill>`, which reads `/logs/tracking/skill_tracking.json`. A background daemon samples skill XP every **fixed 15-second wall-clock tick** (not a sliding window) and the peak is computed as the largest XP delta between two consecutive samples, normalized: `rate = (deltaXp/deltaMs)*60000/8/25` — i.e. raw in-game XP gains are divided by 8 (server runs at 8x speed) and by 25 (this server's bonus XP multiplier). So to maximize score you need to cram as much actual combat/training into ONE 15s wall-clock window as possible — total session XP matters far less than sustained density in the best window.

**How to apply:** Don't optimize for total XP/playtime — optimize for the longest *uninterrupted, high-density* combat stretch (no ammo-outs, no pathing snags, minimal target-switch overhead) so at least one full 15s sample window is saturated.
